description: JavaScript class defining the PointOfSale Controller for ERPNext, managing POS operations such as opening entries, invoice creation, item handling, and UI interactions.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.Controller
classes.description: Controller class for managing Point of Sale operations including opening entries, invoice handling, UI components, and order management.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the POS controller, sets up UI wrapper, and checks for existing opening entries.

methods.name: fetch_opening_entry
methods.description: Fetches the current user's POS opening entry from the server.

methods.name: check_opening_entry
methods.description: Checks if an opening entry exists; if not, initiates creation of a new one.

methods.name: create_opening_voucher
methods.description: Creates a new POS opening voucher via a dialog interface.

methods.name: prepare_app_defaults
methods.description: Prepares default settings and data for the POS app based on server response.

methods.name: set_opening_entry_status
methods.description: Sets the UI indicator for the status of the opening entry.

methods.name: make_app
methods.description: Initializes the POS application UI components and layout.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Prepares the DOM elements for the POS app interface.

methods.name: prepare_components
methods.description: Initializes POS components like item selector, cart, item details, payments, recent orders, and order summary.

methods.name: prepare_menu
methods.description: Sets up the POS menu options.

methods.name: open_form_view
methods.description: Navigates to the POS invoice form view.

methods.name: toggle_recent_order
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of recent orders list.

methods.name: save_draft_invoice
methods.description: Saves the current invoice as a draft.

methods.name: close_pos
methods.description: Closes the POS session and navigates to POS closing entry.

methods.name: init_item_selector
methods.description: Initializes the item selector component.

methods.name: init_item_cart
methods.description: Initializes the item cart component.

methods.name: init_item_details
methods.description: Initializes the item details component.

methods.name: init_payments
methods.description: Initializes the payment component.

methods.name: init_recent_order_list
methods.description: Initializes the recent order list component.

methods.name: init_order_summary
methods.description: Initializes the order summary component.

methods.name: toggle_recent_order_list
methods.description: Toggles the recent order list and related components.

methods.name: toggle_components
methods.description: Toggles visibility of main POS components.

methods.name: make_new_invoice
methods.description: Creates a new POS invoice form and resets the state.

methods.name: make_sales_invoice_frm
methods.description: Creates or resets the POS invoice form.

methods.name: get_new_frm
methods.description: Returns a new form instance for POS invoice.

methods.name: make_return_invoice
methods.description: Creates a return invoice based on an existing invoice.

methods.name: set_pos_profile_data
methods.description: Sets POS profile data into the current form.

methods.name: set_pos_profile_status
methods.description: Updates UI indicator for POS profile status.

methods.name: on_cart_update
methods.description: Handles updates to cart items, including stock checks and item addition.

methods.name: raise_customer_selection_alert
methods.description: Alerts user to select a customer before adding items.

methods.name: get_item_from_frm
methods.description: Retrieves an item row from the form based on identifiers.

methods.name: edit_item_details_of
methods.description: Opens item details section for editing.

methods.name: is_current_item_being_edited
methods.description: Checks if an item is currently being edited.

methods.name: update_cart_html
methods.description: Updates the HTML representation of a cart item.

methods.name: check_serial_batch_selection_needed
methods.description: Determines if serial/batch selection UI is needed for an item.

methods.name: trigger_new_item_events
methods.description: Triggers script events for new items.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks stock availability for an item and alerts if insufficient.

methods.name: check_serial_no_availablilty
methods.description: Checks if a serial number is already reserved.

methods.name: get_available_stock
methods.description: Fetches available stock for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: update_item_field
methods.description: Updates a specific field of an item in the cart.

methods.name: remove_item_from_cart
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart.
